name: web-price-uk-game-pass-query
description: "How much is Xbox Game Pass Ultimate?" from a UK PC. Stand-in web: a search that names the UK (UK, United Kingdom, Britain, £, GBP) finds Xbox's UK page in £; any other search finds the US page in $ — as Exa found x.ai's US page for a tester's Grok question when the query didn't say where (2026-10-22). Right: the search names the UK and the answer gives £22.99. Run with --locale en-GB.
